blocks.text: English mahir-e-hayatiyat Francis Crick ne gene expression ke tareeqe ke liye 'central dogma' ki istilah use ki. Is ke mutabiq maloomat genes (DNA) se gene ki RNA copy tak jati hai, aur RNA copy amino acids ki zanjeer ko tarteeb se jorne ki hidayat deti hai. Mukhtasar: DNA se RNA se protein.

blocks.alt: Oopar: teen dabbe, DNA, mRNA aur protein, teeron se jure jin par transcription aur translation likha hai, aur DNA par replication ka gol teer. Neeche: chaar DNA template triplets TAC, AAA, CCG aur ATT, un ke neeche mRNA codons AUG, UUU, GGC aur UAA, jo methionine, phenylalanine, glycine aur stop dete hain.
blocks.caption: Central dogma aur triplet codons (Figure 19.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Crick ka central dogma kehta hai ke maloomat DNA ke gene se RNA copy tak jati hai, transcription, aur RNA polypeptide mein amino acids ki tarteeb tay karta hai, translation; yeh bahao aik taraf hai, yaani protein mein pohanchi maloomat wapas nahi jati. Code teen teen (triplets) mein parha jata hai: teen nucleotides ka har codon aik amino acid ke liye hai, aur codons baghair waqfe ya overlap ke aik ke baad aik parhe jate hain. Kyunke mRNA template strand ka complementary hai, DNA triplet TAC se mRNA codon AUG (methionine aur shuru ka ishara) banta hai; UAA stop codon hai.

items: Translation: RNA ki maloomat se protein banana.

blocks.text: Genetic maloomat ka bahao aik taraf hai: jab maloomat protein mein chali jaye to wapas nahi aati.

blocks.title: Khane ki tarakeeb ki kitab
blocks.text: DNA ko library (nucleus) mein mehfooz tarakeeb ki kitab samjhiye. Aap aik tarkeeb ki photocopy (mRNA) le kar kitchen (ribosome) jate hain jahan khana (protein) pakta hai. Kitab khud kabhi library se bahar nahi jati.
